name: EMNIST: Extended MNIST
description: The EMNIST (Extended MNIST) dataset is an extension of MNIST to handwritten letters and digits. Derived from the NIST Special Database 19, it matches the 28x28 pixel format of MNIST and provides several standardized splits including By_Class (814,255 samples, 62 classes), Balanced (131,600 samples, 47 classes), and Letters (145,600 samples, 26 classes).
